🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
tanh计算双曲正切值
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)
ts_rank滚动排名（当前值在 n 期窗口内的百分位排名）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 volume：volume
  3. 计算 high：high
  4. 计算 low：low
  5. 计算 mom：close / close.shift(5) - 1
  6. 计算 tr：np.maximum(high - low, np.maximum((high - close.shift(1)).abs(), (low - close.shift(1)).abs()))
  7. 计算 atr：tr.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).mean()
  8. 计算 vol_adj：atr / close
  9. 计算 vol_mean：vol_adj.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).mean()
  10. 计算 vol_std：vol_adj.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1)
  11. 计算 vol_z：(vol_adj - vol_mean) / vol_std
  12. 计算 vol_z_clipped：np.clip(vol_z, -2, 2)
  13. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  14. 计算 ema_ret：ret.ewm(span=7, min_periods=7, adjust=False).mean()
  15. 计算 persistence：np.tanh(ema_ret * 5)
  16. 计算 base_mom：(mom / (1 + vol_z_clipped.abs())) * (1 + persistence)
  17. 计算 vol_ma20：volume.滚动窗口(20).mean()
  18. 计算 volume_dev：(volume - vol_ma20) / vol_ma20
  19. 计算 herding：np.sign(ret) * np.tanh(volume_dev * 3)
  20. 计算 vol_rank：volume.滚动窗口(12).rank(pct=True)
  21. 计算 vol_ma10：volume.滚动窗口(10).mean()
  22. 计算 vol_trend：volume.滚动窗口(3).mean() / vol_ma10
  23. 计算 confidence：1 + np.tanh(vol_rank * vol_trend)
  24. 计算 factor：base_mom * (1 + np.tanh(herding)) * confidence
  25. 计算 factor：factor.clip(-5, 5)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_vol_gated_herding_mutated(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] volume = df_copy["str">'volume'] high = df_copy["str">'high'] low = df_copy["str">'low'] "com"># Parent1: momentum "kw">class="kw">and volatility adjustment (same as parent) mom = close / close.shift(5) - 1 tr = np.maximum(high - low, np.maximum((high - close.shift(1)).abs(), (low - close.shift(1)).abs())) atr = tr.rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean() vol_adj = atr / close vol_mean = vol_adj.rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean() vol_std = vol_adj.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1) vol_z = (vol_adj - vol_mean) / vol_std.replace(0, np.nan) vol_z_clipped = np.clip(vol_z, -2, 2) ret = close.pct_change() ema_ret = ret.ewm(span=7, min_periods=7, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() persistence = np.tanh(ema_ret * 5) base_mom = (mom / (1 + vol_z_clipped.abs())) * (1 + persistence) "com"># Mutated herding: volume-signed "kw">class="kw">return strength vol_ma20 = volume.rolling(20).mean() volume_dev = (volume - vol_ma20) / vol_ma20.replace(0, np.nan) herding = np.sign(ret) * np.tanh(volume_dev * 3) "com"># Volume confidence with shorter windows vol_rank = volume.rolling(12).rank(pct="kw">class="kw">True) vol_ma10 = volume.rolling(10).mean() vol_trend = volume.rolling(3).mean() / vol_ma10.replace(0, np.nan) confidence = 1 + np.tanh(vol_rank * vol_trend) "com"># Combine factor = base_mom * (1 + np.tanh(herding)) * confidence factor = factor.fillna(0.0).clip(-5, 5) df_copy["str">'factor_vol_gated_herding_mutated'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_vol_gated_herding_mutated']
